title: Nutrition targets
subtitle: What we suggest you eat in a day, and exactly how we arrived at it.
disclaimerContext: Every figure on this page comes from a prototype calculator, not from a clinician.

empty.title: You do not have a target yet
empty.body: Answer a few questions about you and how you eat, and we will calculate a daily energy and macronutrient target — showing every step of the arithmetic.

provenance.note: Produced by MockNutritionTargetEngine — a prototype that applies published, cited equations. It is not a clinical tool, and the figures it produces are estimates.

energy.title: Energy
energy.ringLabel: Your target as a share of your estimated maintenance energy
energy.maintenanceDescription: Roughly what you would eat to hold your weight steady.
energy.targetDescription: Maintenance, moved by your goal and the pace you chose.
energy.toleranceDescription: A day inside this band counts as on target. Nobody hits a figure exactly.
energy.restingRateDescription: What the equation estimates you use at complete rest, before any activity.

macros.title: Protein, carbohydrate, fat and fibre
macros.lead: Grams first, because that is what you can actually count. The percentages are the same figures expressed as a share of your energy target.

override.who: {{dietitian}} replaced part of this calculation on {{when}}.
override.energyUnchanged: The energy target is still the calculated one.
override.energyReplaced: The energy target was replaced with {{value}} kcal a day. The calculation's own working is kept below, so you can see what changed.
override.macrosUnchanged: The macronutrient split is still the calculated one.
override.macrosReplaced: The macronutrient split was replaced entirely. The calculation's own working is kept below, so you can see what changed.
override.absentBody: Every figure on this page is what the calculator produced. Nobody has changed one.

explanation.noCitations: No published source applied to this calculation.

review.action: Ask a dietitian to review this
review.hint: Sends your target to a qualified professional. You keep using your plan while you wait.
review.requiredTitle: A qualified person should look at this
review.requiredBody: The calculator flagged this target: {{reasons}}. It is an estimate from published general-population equations, and it knows nothing about medical conditions, medication or pregnancy.
review.pendingTitle: Your request is with a dietitian
review.pendingBody: It is on a professional's queue. Nothing about your plan changes while you wait.
review.errorTitle: We could not send your request
review.errorBody: Nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.

recalculate.hint: Runs your saved answers through the calculator again. The figures only change if something behind them has.
recalculate.errorBody: Your saved target is unchanged. Try again in a moment.

energy_floor_applied.title: The target hit the minimum-intake guard
energy_floor_applied.body: Your goal and pace produced a figure below the guard value this calculator uses, so the target was raised to it. That guard is an interface safeguard, not a clinical recommendation, and hitting it is a good reason to speak to somebody qualified.

aggressive_deficit.title: An ambitious pace with a weight-loss goal
aggressive_deficit.body: This is the largest deficit the calculator will produce. It is harder to keep to than a steadier pace, and general guidance is more cautious about it.

safety_critical_restriction.title: You recorded an allergy or a medical restriction
safety_critical_restriction.body: A general-population equation cannot account for one. The figures still stand as an estimate; a qualified person can tell you whether they suit your situation.

under_eighteen.title: You are under eighteen
under_eighteen.body: The equations behind this estimate were fitted on adults, and energy needs during growth are a different question. This one really should come from a professional.

over_seventy_five.title: You are over seventy-five
over_seventy_five.body: Resting-energy equations lose accuracy at the ends of their fitted range, and other factors matter more at this age than the arithmetic does.

very_low_body_mass_index.title: Your body-mass index is very low
very_low_body_mass_index.body: Outside the range these equations were fitted on, the estimate is less reliable — and a target is not the first thing worth discussing.

very_high_body_mass_index.title: Your body-mass index is very high
very_high_body_mass_index.body: Outside the range these equations were fitted on, the estimate is less reliable. A qualified person can tell you what to do with it.

high_body_fat_percentage.title: The body-fat percentage you gave is high
high_body_fat_percentage.body: The body-composition equation becomes less reliable here, and a measured figure from a professional would be worth more than an estimate.

client_requested_review.title: You asked for a review
client_requested_review.body: A dietitian will look at this target and either approve it or suggest a change.
